description: This file defines the InputConfigurator class in the Drupal core, responsible for collecting, validating, and describing input data for recipes, including handling default values from config, environment, or static values.

classes.name: InputConfigurator
classes.description: Final class responsible for managing input data for recipes, including collecting, describing, and validating inputs, with support for default values from config, environment, or static sources.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the InputConfigurator with input definitions, dependencies, a prefix, and a typed data manager, converting definitions into typed data definitions.

methods.name: getDataDefinitions
methods.description: Returns typed data definitions for the inputs defined by this recipe, excluding dependencies.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns the collected input values, or an empty array if none have been collected.

methods.name: describeAll
methods.description: Provides descriptions for all inputs of this recipe and its dependencies, keyed by fully qualified name.

methods.name: collectAll
methods.description: Collects input values for this recipe and dependencies, validating constraints and handling default values.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves the default value for an input based on its definition, sourcing from config, environment, or static value.
